what: The decoder module (conversion/clef_flash/qwen3_5_clef_decoder.py) in fp32 torch against the author's fp32 oracle, read through the author's own JointSchemaHead: P1 every oracle run, P2 bit equality with the overlay's plain Qwen3.5 text decoder, P3 per layer, P4 red arms, P5 chunk widths 16 / 32 / 64, CPU vs MPS. Then the host spec (conversion/clef_flash/host.py) against every oracle run: ids, image offset, spans, option order, static inputs, M-RoPE planes, pixel_values.

removed: p1.runs[].questions[].probs (the module's probabilities; each question keeps max / mean |dp|, max |dlogit|, the argmax pair and the oracle margin)
p1.runs[].layer_hashes (per chunk x layer hashes of 3 runs; p2 keeps chunk_layer_hashes_equal per run)
trimmed.full_copies: the source files above, in the lane directory $ZOO_WORK_ROOT/_clefflash/ (not in the repository)

parity.purpose: the hidden-output decoder module (fp32 torch, S-token chunks from fresh zero states, unrolled GDN step scan, in-graph M-RoPE, ids input with image rows on a static input) vs the author's fp32 oracle, read through the author's JointSchemaHead

harness.depthwise_conv: CPU: one torch.bmm over the conv windows (no oneDNN in this torch build), checked against F.conv1d (torch.equal, all channels, all 24 layers) at the last chunk of every CPU run; MPS: F.conv1d

oracle.image_embeds: oracle npz image_embeds (HF fp32 tower merger output), zero-padded to the buffer

contract.image: <|image_pad|> -> V + k (row-major), image_rc[k] = (k // W, k % W), start = 37 + N, amount = N - max(H, W) (i0 = 36)
contract.chunks: ceil(T / S) chunks from zero states, position_ids = 0..cursor+S-1, the last chunk padded with 248044, padded outputs discarded

device_check.what: the module in fp32, S=16 chunks, fresh zero states: CPU (bmm depthwise conv, checked against F.conv1d) vs MPS (F.conv1d), hidden at every position and the author's head on each

host.what: host.build_ids / static_inputs / rope_positions / preprocess vs every oracle run
